voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: The Atlantic, January nineteen forty-eight. A British airliner, the Star Tiger, was flying through the night to Bermuda. It never arrived.
Just after three in the morning, she asked Bermuda for a radio bearing. Nothing more was heard.
Thirty-one people were aboard. The search found no wreckage. No one aboard was ever seen again.
The official inquiry wrote that no more baffling problem had ever been presented for investigation.
Theories include fuel running out, and sabotage. The wreck has never been found.
